kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِحْرَنْجَمَ • (iḥranjama) IIIq (non-past يَحْرَنْجِمُ (yaḥranjimu), verbal noun اِحْرِنْجَام (iḥrinjām))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Compare حَرْجَمَ (ḥarjama, “to drive back towards each other”).
g: to press one another, (intransitive) to crowd
